payload.summary: Implemented the four compute-only packages of the adaptive model router in a cloud session (no test Postgres / Node): wp-contracts, wp-resolver core, wp-feedback core, wp-dispatch. 22/56 tasks, 64 new tests green (mypy --strict + ruff clean), 142 existing skills tests still passing. Remaining packages are DB/Cedar/Node-gated and should run in a local environment.
completed_work: wp-contracts: generated Pydantic models + contract parity tests (tasks 1.1-1.4)
wp-resolver core: resolver.py scoring (D3/D9/D13) + exploration.py budget (D6) + feasibility filter (D10) (3.1-3.3,3.5,3.6)
wp-feedback core: feedback.py weighted decayed aggregation (D9) + roadmap normalizers (5.1-5.3)
wp-dispatch: OpenAICompatAdapter (D10) + catalog-priced policy.py replacing the cost stub (D7) + exploration gate (D6) (4.1-4.5)

decisions.title: Sequential single-checkout execution instead of coordinated worktree fleet
decisions.rationale: Cloud session short-circuits worktree isolation (isolation_provided=true); parallel agents would share one checkout and clobber. Drove the DAG order manually.

decisions.title: Split each package into a pure compute core (built now) and a DB/app shell (deferred)
decisions.rationale: Scoring, exploration, feasibility, feedback aggregation, and the dispatch adapter are dependency-free and fully unit-testable; only candidate-fetch/persistence needs Postgres.

decisions.title: set_catalog_pricing hook instead of importing the coordinator into skills
decisions.rationale: policy.py must stay decoupled from the coordinator process; default None preserves the pre-change static-tier behavior (Rule 4).

decisions.title: OpenAICompatAdapter in a sibling module with injectable transport
decisions.rationale: Keeps the ~1500-line review_dispatcher diff reviewable and makes the adapter network-free testable; discovery-chain rewiring defers until the catalog supplies base_urls.

next_steps: Local env: implement migration 028 + catalog/refresher/ledger (wp-db-catalog), then wire resolver.select via /routing/* and MCP
Then wp-probes (quota/ToS/canary), Cedar policy files (3.4), wp-dashboard (apps/usage-viz), wp-integration
